### Checklist

- [ ] If this is not a feature request but a general question, please start a discussion at https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/discussions. Otherwise, it will be closed.
- [ ] Please use English. Otherwise, it will be closed.

## Motivation

Enable DeepSeek-V4.1 with prefill/decode disaggregation and DSpark, covering target-state transfer, draft initialization, verification/commit, prefix-cache restoration, and request lifecycle correctness.

Baseline: #38798

## Current

V4.1 currently rejects PD with speculative decoding. C2 state is transferred as an entire request ring, but ring capacity depends on the local speculative configuration: 2 without speculation, otherwise the smallest power of two ≥ num_draft_tokens + 2.

For a processed prefix of N=101, the pending token is at position 100: slot 0 with R_P=2, but slot 4 with R_D=8. Both the request stride and the intra-request offset differ; changing only the copy length is insufficient.

## Implementation

### C2 boundary-state transfer 
Transfer only the pending FP32 (kv, score) row at a committed handoff boundary. Register C2 items at row granularity; each endpoint computes its own row index. Preserve C128 semantics and reject incompatible transfer formats.
```
N even：no C2 payload
N odd：
  p = N - 1
  src_row = p_req_slot * R_P + p % R_P
  dst_row = d_req_slot * R_D + p % R_D
```
N excludes a sampled token that has not completed forward execution.

### Complete DSpark 
Ensure D receives or reconstructs all target Main KV, Indexer K, SWA and compression state, plus the draft KV/target-hidden-derived state required by DSpark. Audit V4.1 capture points and token-position alignment; P-side execution must not depend on matching D’s ring capacity.

### Verification and lifecycle
Validate the first draft/verify step, partial/full rejection, accepted-token commit, C2 state reuse, and Engram-history updates. Order transfer completion before D execution and source release; prevent stale writes after cancellation or request-slot reuse.

### Prefix-cache correctness
Distinguish cache-resume boundary H from PD handoff boundary N. Existing even page-aligned hits need no cached pending pair at H; suffix execution regenerates the state needed at N. Odd hits require a prefix-keyed pending snapshot or fallback to an earlier recoverable even boundary.

A global-KV hit is not a complete state hit. Restore SWA, Engram and draft state independently; never skip pending restoration solely because the global-KV transfer is empty. Decode-side radix-cache restrictions must be handled explicitly, not silently bypassed.

### Transfer Cost

One C2 row is 512 × 2 × 4 = 4096 bytes. Across source layers 2, 8, 14, the logical payload is 12 KiB for odd N, zero for even N, independent of context length and ring capacity.

## Acceptance Criteria

End-to-end PD + DSpark generation with Mooncake and NIXL, including streaming and concurrent requests.
Cover unequal ring sizes, odd/even lengths, wraparound, chunked prefill, prefix hits, rejection, cancellation and slot reuse.
Compare state and generation against suitable non-disaggregated references; measure actual speculative acceptance and throughput.
Remove the blanket rejection only after the complete path is validated; document supported configurations and retain guards for unimplemented combinations.
